checks.name: Backend verify incl. ContactIntegrationTest, EgyptianPhoneTest, ProviderConfigurationTest, identity regression
Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity
Local stack verify incl. dev zone fixtures and OIDC login

scenarios.observed: ContactIntegrationTest: after verifying +201011112222 the checkout contact policy passes; starting a challenge for +201033334444 replaces the stored number, clears phone_verified_at and the policy throws CONTACT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED until the new number is verified; a code issued for the previous number can no longer verify. Quote/order endpoints that call this policy arrive in MB-017.

Wrong code 422 and not verified; correct code verifies once; replaying the used code 422; expired code (clock +5m1s) 422 and not verified; 5 wrong attempts then the correct code returns 429 and the account stays unverified; resend within 60 s 429; 6th send in an hour 429; same number from another account blocked by the per-number limit; another account's challenge 404. Only an HMAC is stored and captured application logs do not contain the code. A mutation removing the expiry check made the expiry test fail.

Customer B listing, patching or archiving customer A's address id gets no A data (404) and A's row is unchanged; addresses require recipient, phone, governorate, city, active zone, street and building; inactive zone 422 ZONE_NOT_SERVED; unpaired coordinates 422; a privileged userId field 400; stale version 409; archive is soft. Quote creation with another user's address is enforced in MB-017 via owner-scoped address lookup.

Profile/address APIs, Egyptian normalization (18 normalization cases), OTP adapter with isolated fake sender (deployed environments refuse the fake), verification limits, deletion-request intake (disables access, idempotent retry) and cross-account address rejection pass on PostgreSQL through the real security chain; contract and registry updated (API-011..017 implemented).

findings: Repairs during story: nested records in package-private services were not visible to the web layer; registry edit regex skipped templated paths (caught by the parity test) and was redone line-targeted; brittle migration version assertion now compares applied versions with shipped files; local stack lacked the dev profile so zone fixtures never loaded.
Residual: per-number hourly limit lets an attacker exhaust a victim number's sends for an hour (accepted trade-off against SMS flooding; revisit in MB-036 rate-limit review).
Residual: no real SMS provider (O07); deployed environments fail fast by design. Deletion purge/retention follows O06 (open).
TC-003/TC-005 quote-path assertions depend on MB-017 and will be re-exercised there.
